title: Zesty Smoked Jamaican Morbier Tagine
description: A light and silky Jamaican dish featuring Morbier cheese, smoked to perfection in a tagine pot, with a zesty twist. This raw-friendly recipe is perfect for a unique dinner experience.
instructions: Preheat the tagine pot over medium heat, adding the coconut oil to the bottom.
Add the diced scotch bonnet peppers and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the sliced red onion and cook for an additional 3 minutes, until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Add the sliced Morbier cheese, stirring gently to combine with the spice mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and silky.
Stir in the chopped fresh cilantro and lime juice.
Serve the Zesty Smoked Jamaican Morbier Tagine hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
